data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme investing in government securities across maturity
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the Scheme is to generate return through investments in sovereign securities issued by the Central Government and / or a State Government and / or any security unconditionally guaranteed by the central Government and/ or State Government for repayment of Principal and Interest.
data.asset_allocation: Securities issued by the Central/State Government and/or securities unconditionally guaranteed by the Central/State : 80% -100% Debt & Money Market Instruments : 0-20%
